title: Nell and the Best Spot
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.text: Nell spots a warm, bright spot on the path.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering above a patch of gravel path lit up by a bright shaft of sunlight.
Pip the sparrow hopping over towards the sunny spot on the path, looking at it keenly.
Moss the hedgehog shuffling towards the same sunny spot on the path.
Fig the caterpillar crawling slowly towards the sunny spot on the path, antennae raised.

pages.text: Four of them can not all fit.
pages.illustration: Nell, Pip, Moss and Fig all crowded at the edge of the small sunny spot, too little room for everyone.

pages.text: Nell has a plan: take turns.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering in front of the others, one leg raised as if explaining a plan.

pages.text: Nell sets a turn for each one.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee lining the other three up in a row beside the sunny spot, each waiting their turn.

pages.text: Pip sits first, then it is Moss.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting in the sunny spot while Moss the hedgehog waits just behind him.

pages.text: Then Fig gets a turn in the sun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar now resting in the sunny spot, stretched out happily.

pages.text: Nell gets the best turn: the last one.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee finally settling into the sunny spot, wings relaxed, looking pleased.
